acceptance_checks.when: _site/ is scanned for third-party font CDN references
acceptance_checks.then: no fonts.googleapis, fonts.gstatic, or cdnjs.cloudflare substring appears anywhere in _site/
the build exits 0 and introduces no new Sass error
acceptance_checks.verify_method: bundle exec jekyll build; exit code 0

acceptance_checks.then: assets/fonts/*.woff2 exist on disk and are copied into _site/assets/fonts/
acceptance_checks.verify_method: 7 .woff2 files present in both assets/fonts/ and _site/assets/fonts/

acceptance_checks.then: every url(...) resolves to a shipped local file
acceptance_checks.verify_method: every url(...) in assets/fonts/fontawesome.min.css names a file that exists in the same directory

acceptance_checks.when: the local Font Awesome CSS loads
acceptance_checks.then: the v4/v5-compat alias resolves to the solid glyph set
acceptance_checks.verify_method: fontawesome.min.css contains the alias; fontTools cmap confirms U+F073 and U+F017 in fa-solid-900.woff2

acceptance_checks.given: fas fa-scroll, fas fa-flask, fab fa-github
acceptance_checks.when: the local CSS and shipped webfonts are inspected
acceptance_checks.then: each class has a content rule and a glyph at that codepoint
acceptance_checks.verify_method: CSS content rules present; fontTools cmap confirms the codepoints

acceptance_checks.given: npm run test:a11y-static is the project trust anchor
Inter, Roboto, Nothing You Could Do referenced across _sass/
acceptance_checks.when: self-hosted @font-face rules replace the CDN stylesheet
acceptance_checks.then: every family name and referenced weight resolves to a registered @font-face
